name: scala-notebook-shadow
description: Shows Metals compile diagnostics as squiggles in Scala Jupyter notebook cells via a hidden scala-cli shadow script.

enumDescriptions: Lifecycle events: shadow files created, compiles started and finished.
Adds per-request detail: which file answered a language request and how many results survived mapping into cells. Start here when a feature returns nothing.
Adds high-frequency detail, notably completion result counts.
scalaNotebook.logLevel.description: Verbosity of the Scala Notebook Shadow output channel. Takes effect immediately; no reload needed. Run "Scala Notebook: Show Log" to open the channel.

scalaNotebook.completionResolveCount.description: How many completion items to have Metals resolve (documentation, detail and auto-import edits) before they are shown. Relayed completions are never resolved on demand, so an unresolved item shows an empty documentation pane. Each resolve is a round trip to Metals; 0 disables resolution.

scalaNotebook.codeActionResolveCount.description: How many code actions to have Metals resolve (the edits of a lazily-computed refactor) before they are offered. A relayed code action is never resolved on demand, so an unresolved one would appear in the lightbulb menu and then do nothing. 0 disables resolution.

scalaNotebook.scalaVersion.description: Scala version written into the shadow file's `//> using scala` directive. Must match the kernel you run, otherwise phantom errors.

scalaNotebook.mvnDeps.description: Dependency coordinates written into the shadow file as `//> using dep` directives, e.g. com.lihaoyi::upickle:4.0.2. Merged with dependencies discovered from `import $ivy` lines.

scalaNotebook.almondVersion.description: Almond version whose predef the shadow file reproduces: adds a `//> using dep sh.almond::jupyter-api:<version>` directive, a `//> using repository` for JitPack, and Almond's predef imports (Markdown, Html, publish, ...) before the first cell. Set to an empty string to leave the prelude out.

scalaNotebook.ammoniteVersion.description: Ammonite version behind the kernel, whose `repl` and `interp` bridges the shadow file puts in scope: adds a `//> using dep com.lihaoyi:ammonite-repl-api_3.3.7:<version>` directive and the bridge imports before the first cell. Should match the Ammonite your Almond version embeds. Set to an empty string to leave them out.

scalaNotebook.preamble.description: Lines inserted after the header, before the first cell (e.g. Almond predef imports).

scalaNotebook.shadowDir.description: Directory, relative to the first workspace folder, where shadow .sc files are written. Metals starts a scala-cli build server for it on its own; no build file is needed.

scalaNotebook.debounceMs.description: Milliseconds to debounce shadow file regeneration after a notebook edit.

scalaNotebook.compileOnSave.description: Ask Metals to cascade-compile the workspace after a regenerated shadow file is saved, so diagnostics refresh promptly.
